win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: RO$$ AND HOT RO$$ SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When a Ro$$ or Hot Ro$$ symbol lands, it expands if the symbol would be part of at least one winning combination once expanded. Expanded Ro$$ or Hot Ro$$ symbols count as Wild on every position that the expanded symbol covers. Ro$$ symbols that do not expand are counted as a single Wild symbol. Only one Ro$$ or Hot Ro$$ symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 Ro$$ symbols expand downward, to the bottom of the grid from where the symbol landed.

 When a Hot Ro$$ symbol triggers, it moves to the top of the reel, and expands downward to cover the entire reel it landed on. Expanded Hot Ro$$ Reels trigger Ro$$ symbols on adjacent reels directly to the left and right to move to the top of the reel and expand to cover the entire reel.

 When a Ro$$ or Hot Ro$$ symbol expands through a Wild symbol it turns into a Multiplier that is applied to the entire expanded Ro$$ symbol or Hot Ro$$ Reel. If a Ro$$ symbol or Hot Ro$$ Reel expands through multiple Wild symbols, the Multiplier values will be added together for one total Multiplier value. Wild Multipliers can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 When a winning combination includes more than one expanded Ro$$ symbol or Hot Ro$$ Reel with a Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win the symbols are part of.

wilds.name: EPIC BONUS - BIGG BOSS ROSS
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the CAT CALLS bonus. In addition, at least two Hot Ro$$ and one Wild symbol is guaranteed on every spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 FS symbols cannot land below a Ro$$ symbol and FS symbols cannot land on the same reel as a Hot Ro$$ symbol.

 If four or more reels are activated in NINE LIVES, FS symbols cannot land.
